profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Dhara is a  Sr.Programmer Analyst. She has worked in cross-functional teams through development, maintenance and releases. Seeking for a challenging position as a Software Lead Developer that utilizes her skill set, experience and provides grown opportunity.

2+ Years of experience in JavaScript Framework.
5+ Years of experience in .NET development.
5+ Years of experience in SQL Server, JavaScript Development.
5+ Years of experience in YUI , jQuery.
Excellent knowledge in SQL Server Reporting Services.

Specialties:.NET 3.5, .NET 4.0, SQL Server 2005/2008, YUI, jQuery, Crystal Reports, SSRS, CSS, XML, Webservices, AX Dynamics, AJAX, TFS, jQuery, JSON, HTML5 and CSS3, BootStrap, Kendo UI, Knockout js, Angular js, LESS,

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Year 2020 brought many things, some good and some bad. It brought "SpiceizRight" to me, my own food and gardening blog. It is one of the many endeavors I always wanted and quarantine life helped me achieve it.🙂
Over 25k page views in first year.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed, designed, tested and maintained the application using ASP.NET MVC 4.0 with Razor syntax, knockout binding C#.NET, AJAX, JQuery, JSON, HTML5, JavaScript, Bootstrap and CSS3.
Client side validations of views were done using jquery validators and incorporated for server side validation
Designed UI pages with Razor views and partial views
Used shared layouts, CSS for the consistent look of the application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web based application using C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, SQL-Server 2008/2005, Visual Studio 2008/05, LINQ, CSS and IIS
Database design and development, for creating complex database queries, writing Constraints, Indexes, Views, Stored Procedures and Functions using T-SQL in SQL Server 2005/2008.
